title: Add a Repository City overview page
request: Create a dedicated page on the existing React website describing the webe-city project using only a resident-approved high-level overview. Link it from the main navigation and provide navigation back to About. Preserve the current design, About content, accessibility, and GitHub Pages project-path behavior. Do not expose private source code, city records, credentials, personal information, or unapproved operational details. Delivery requires the applicable city authorization; push, merge, publication, deployment, workflow changes, and making webe-city public are not authorized by this petition.
acceptanceCriteria: A dedicated Repository City page explains the resident-approved purpose, resident and agent roles, request-to-delivery workflow, and pilot limitations in original concise prose without copying private source or records.
Main navigation reaches the new page and returns to About; direct loading and refresh work beneath /webe-website/ without requiring server rewrites.

Existing About content and visual design are preserved; both pages support semantic landmarks, skip navigation, keyboard focus, reduced motion, accessible contrast, and no horizontal overflow at 320px and desktop widths.
Related documentation and tests cover both pages and navigation; the production build and site checks pass with assets resolving under /webe-website/.

Delivery stays within site on a non-default branch plus required separate city administrative records, with independent inspection and resident acceptance before merge; no push, public release, deployment, workflow changes, or change to webe-city visibility is performed without separate approval.
